title: 持续高温干旱重创欧洲农业
title_en: Sustained heat and drought batter European agriculture
summary: 今年入夏以来，欧洲持续高温少雨，农业遭受重创。欧盟及英国约半数土地遭遇不同程度干旱，9%达“警报”级别，法国、德国、匈牙利、罗马尼亚和英国旱情集中，卢瓦尔河、波河、莱茵河、多瑙河水位极低。欧盟多种作物单产预期下调，玉米和向日葵降6%至7%，
summary_en: Since the start of summer this year, Europe has experienced persistent high temperatures and low rainfall, dealing a severe blow to agriculture. About half of the land in the EU and the UK has been hit by varying degrees of drought, with 9% at 'alert' level. Drought conditions are concentrated in France, Germany, Hungary, Romania, and the UK, with the Loire, Po, Rhine, and Danube rivers at extremely low water levels. The EU has lowered yield expectations for multiple crops, with corn and sunflower down 6% to 7%.

summary_en: State Council Taiwan Affairs Office spokesperson Zhang Han said at a regular press conference that enhanced cooperation and exchanges between compatriots on both sides of the Taiwan Strait is an unstoppable historical trend, and cross-strait youth exchanges are a "hope project" that benefits the present and future generations. summary_en: The 24th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th National People's Congress was held in Beijing on August 25, chaired by Chairman Zhao Leji. summary_en: A People's Daily article refuted the Western so-called "China squeeze" theory, citing American scholars who called it political mobilization rhetoric, and identified three smokescreens: misjudging manufacturing competitiveness by labor force size; counting only market share while ignoring complementary and win-win global supply chains; and concealing the historical roots of the Global South's industrialization being blocked by the old international economic order. The article cited World Bank experts.
